title: Principal Scientist - Firefly Enterprise
description:
**Principal Scientist:** Firefly Enterprise India
  
  

The Opportunity
  
Firefly Enterprise brings Adobe's generative AI and creative technology into the heart of enterprise content production by helping large organizations create, adapt, and deliver on\-brand content at production scale, inside the tools their teams already use.
  
  

**Our charter spans two areas:**  

**Audio/Video Solutions:** The media\-processing backbone for enterprise\-scale content production: ingesting, transforming, generating, and delivering audio and video reliably at production volume.
  
**Extensibility:** Enterprise agentic workflows and plug\-ins that surface Firefly's enterprise capabilities directly inside Figma and other Adobe creative applications.
  
We're looking for a Principal Scientist to be the technical anchor of a small, fast\-growing team; a player\-coach who is as comfortable in the architecture and the codebase as in a design review or a customer conversation.
  
This is a senior individual\-contributor role. You won't carry direct reports or own headcount, but you will set the technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and mentor a team of software and machine\-learning engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering managers on people leadership, and you'll be instrumental in interviewing and holding the hiring bar high.
  
Impact You'll Make
  
Set the long\-term technical architecture and vision across both charter areas.
  
Make enterprise\-scale reliability and resiliency a first\-class property of everything the team ships.
  
Bring AI capabilities into the product and into how the team builds, raising both customer value and engineering velocity.
  
Grow a scaling team of software and machine\-learning engineers through hands\-on work and mentorship, i.e., lifting the technical bar by example.
  
Turn customer and field insight into a credible, deliverable roadmap in partnership with adjacent teams.
  
What You'll Do
  
Own the architecture for enterprise\-scale audio/video media\-processing pipelines by designing for throughput, latency, cost, and operational resilience at production volume.
  
**Architect the extensibility platform :** agentic enterprise workflows and plug\-ins that expose Firefly's enterprise capabilities inside Figma and other Adobe creative apps.
  
Stay hands\-on by writing code, leading design and architecture reviews, and setting the engineering standards the team builds to.
  
Mentor developers and specialists in machine learning alike, growing their technical judgment through the work.
  
**Play an instrumental role in hiring:** interview, calibrate, and keep the bar high.
  
Interface directly with customers and field/sales teams to identify real problems and collaborate across adjacent teams to shape the roadmap and deliver solutions.
  
Manage collaborators and expectations across engineering, product, and the field; with clarity and follow\-through.
  
Leverage AI capabilities to improve both what customers get and how the team develops software.
  
What You'll Bring
  
15\+ years building large\-scale distributed software systems.
  
Proven experience operating at enterprise scale with a deep focus on reliability and resiliency .
  
Strong backend engineering in Java, Python, or comparable technologies, with a solid command of distributed systems and cloud\-native platforms.
  
Experience with at least one of the team's two domains, and the ability to ramp on the other:
  
**Media processing:** audio/video pipelines, transcoding, streaming, or large\-scale media workflows.
  
**Extensibility:** SDKs, plug\-in architectures, integration frameworks, or agentic systems.
  
A track record of mentoring both software engineers and machine\-learning engineers and raising the technical bar across a team.
  
Comfort working directly with customers and field/sales teams to translate problems into solutions.
  
Strong collaborator management with the ability to set expectations and align across engineering, product, and the field.
  
Excellent communication and the ability to make complex architecture legible to engineers, product leaders, and executives.
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience employing AI capabilities for both customer\-facing value and internal product development.
  
Familiarity with LLM application architectures, RAG, AI orchestration frameworks, MCP, or agentic systems.
  
Experience building integrations or plug\-ins for Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, or comparable creative ecosystems.
  
Depth in enterprise\-scale media processing, namely, codecs, streaming infrastructure, or GPU\-accelerated media pipelines.
  
Familiarity with enterprise identity, security, governance, and compliance frameworks.
  
Contributions to open\-source software or widely adopted developer platforms.
  
  

About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  

Let’s Adobe together
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .
  
  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**  

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience .

title: Python Backend Engineer
description:
**About Us****SCRY AI** is an innovative AI\-driven technology company focused on building intelligent, scalable, and high\-performance solutions. We work with modern technologies across Software Engineering, AI/ML, and Data to solve real\-world business problems and deliver impactful digital products. **Role Overview**
We are looking for a skilled **Software Engineer \- Python Backend** with strong experience in building **scalable APIs, backend services, and database\-driven applications**. The ideal candidate should be hands\-on with Python, asynchronous programming, SQL, and API development, and comfortable working closely with UI/Frontend teams to deliver reliable end\-to\-end solutions. **Key Responsibilities*** Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance backend applications using **Python**.
* Build robust **REST APIs and backend services** using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
* Develop asynchronous and concurrent applications using **asyncio, background workers, queues, and multiprocessing** where required.
* Design and optimize **database schemas, SQL queries, joins, indexes, stored procedures, and transactions**.
* Work extensively with **PostgreSQL/MySQL** and other relational databases.
* Collaborate with UI/Frontend teams on **API contracts, request/response structures, authentication, error handling, and integration**.
* Build APIs capable of handling **high traffic, concurrent requests, and real\-time workloads**.
* Optimize API and database performance by identifying **slow queries, bottlenecks, inefficient calls, and resource utilization issues**.
* Integrate backend services with **third\-party APIs, external systems, and enterprise applications**.
* Implement **authentication, authorization, validation, logging, exception handling, and API security**.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-documented code; develop **unit/integration tests** and participate in code reviews.
* Containerize applications using **Docker** and support deployment, troubleshooting, monitoring, scalability, and reliability across environments.

  

**Key Qualifications*** **3\+ years** of software engineering experience with strong hands\-on experience in **Python**.
* Strong experience with **FastAPI/Flask, REST APIs, asynchronous programming, asyncio, concurrency, background jobs, and message queues**.
* Excellent knowledge of **SQL and relational databases**, particularly PostgreSQL/MySQL, including complex queries, CTEs, joins, aggregations, indexes, and transactions.
* Experience with **database schema design, data modeling, query optimization, connection pooling, and performance tuning**.
* Understanding of **API scalability, caching, high\-concurrency systems, and backend performance optimization**.
* Experience integrating backend APIs with **Frontend/UI applications and third\-party systems**.
* Good understanding of **Git, Docker, Linux, testing, debugging, and CI/CD**.
* Experience with **Redis, Kafka/RabbitMQ**, or similar caching and messaging technologies is a plus.
* Experience with **AWS or other cloud platforms** is preferred.
* Strong **problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, and ownership skills**, with the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

 **Good to Have*** Experience with **Kubernetes, microservices, cloud\-native architectures, and production observability**.
* Exposure to **event\-driven architectures, distributed systems, API gateways, and performance/load testing**.
* Experience working with **AI/ML or GenAI backend integrations** and deploying Python\-based AI services is a plus.

title: Software Development Engineer - III (Backend + AI)
description:
**About the Role:**  

As a Software Development Engineer \- III at Innovaccer, you'll be a senior technical leader who stays deep in the code. You'll personally design and build complex, high\-impact parts of our platform — backend services, data pipelines, and the AI/ML\-powered features that increasingly define our products — while setting the technical direction for your team or domain. This is a builder's role first: you'll write production code, own components end to end, and lead by doing, while also shaping architecture and mentoring the engineers around you. You'll work closely with product, clinical, and engineering peers to turn ambitious healthcare goals into robust, scalable software that ships. If you want to operate at Staff scope without stepping away from the keyboard, this role is for you.

**A day in the Life**

* Design, build, and ship complex, critical components of Innovaccer's platform — backend services, APIs, and data pipelines — writing high\-quality production code yourself.
* Build AI/ML\-powered product features end to end: integrating models, designing the systems and data flows around them, and ensuring they perform reliably in production.
* Drive technical design for systems within your team or domain, making hands\-on decisions for scalability, performance, security, and cost, then implementing them.
* Model engineering best practices across the SDLC — code quality, testing, security, observability, and operational excellence — and raise the bar through the code you write and review.
* Build resilient, well\-tested services that integrate cleanly across products and with external healthcare systems.
* Ensure the software you build complies with healthcare and data\-protection requirements, including HIPAA and GDPR, embedding compliance and security into the implementation.
* Debug, profile, and harden production systems, taking ownership of reliability and incident response for the systems you build.
* Provide hands\-on technical mentorship to engineers through design reviews, pairing, and code review.
* Partner with product and clinical stakeholders to turn real\-world needs into well\-scoped, technically sound designs you can deliver.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, and tooling for your team, balancing capability, cost, risk, and time\-to\-value.

**What you Need**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of personally building and shipping production systems.
* Deep, current, hands\-on coding expertise in one or more modern languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, or similar) — this role writes code daily.
* Strong software design skills across distributed systems, backend services, APIs, and data\-intensive architectures.
* Experience building and integrating AI/ML into products — connecting models to real systems, handling data flows, and operationalizing them in production (you don't need to be a research scientist, but you should be comfortable building AI/ML\-powered features).
* Hands\-on experience operating production systems: CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, monitoring, performance tuning, and incident response.
* Familiarity with healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7\) and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, GDPR), or the ability to ramp quickly on a regulated domain.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and clear communication, with the ability to align engineers and stakeholders around a technical approach.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Backend Developer
description:
**Backend Developer / Data Engineer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses operating across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our work spans regulatory compliance, product safety, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship, brand protection and technology\-enabled compliance solutions across international markets including the UK, USA, India, Europe, GCC/UAE and other global markets.

As our technology and digital capabilities continue to grow, we are looking for a **Backend Developer / Data Engineer** to join our India\-based technology team and help develop reliable systems, data infrastructure and backend services that support our internal operations and technology platforms.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving backend applications, APIs, databases and data pipelines used across GCRS technology platforms and internal systems.

The role combines **backend software development and data engineering**, making it suitable for someone who enjoys building robust systems while also working with structured data, integrations, automation and reporting.

You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

This is a hands\-on role in a growing environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, development standards, automation and the improvement of our overall technology infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services
* Develop secure and reliable APIs and integrations
* Build and maintain databases and data models
* Develop data pipelines for collecting, transforming and processing information
* Integrate internal systems and third\-party services through APIs
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-documented code
* Optimise backend performance, database queries and system reliability
* Develop automated processes for data handling and operational workflows
* Support the development of reporting and analytics infrastructure
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and integrity
* Identify and resolve backend and data\-related issues
* Conduct testing, debugging and performance improvements
* Work with frontend developers to support application functionality
* Collaborate with AI and technology teams where backend or data infrastructure is required
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation
* Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of applications
* Monitor systems and investigate technical issues
* Follow appropriate security and data\-protection practices
* Contribute to technical architecture and development standards
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation and efficiency

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, analytical and comfortable working across backend development and data.

You should enjoy solving problems, understanding how systems work and building reliable solutions rather than simply completing individual coding tasks.

You will need to be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with other technology and business teams.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in backend development, software engineering or data engineering
* Strong knowledge of at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Node.js or similar
* Strong understanding of databases and SQL
* Experience developing APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of data structures and data modelling
* Experience working with relational databases
* Understanding of data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Good understanding of software development principles
* Experience with Git and version control
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of application security and data protection
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to document technical work clearly
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Desirable Experience**

* Python\-based data engineering and development of data processing pipelines.
* PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational database technologies.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Docker for application containerization and deployment.
* Data warehouses, business intelligence systems or analytics platforms.
* Automation and workflow tools used for streamlining data and operational processes.
* AI/ML systems and their integration with data engineering workflows.
* Handling large, complex or high\-volume datasets.
* SaaS, consultancy, technology or professional services environments.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Developed and maintained reliable backend services
* Improved the performance and stability of existing systems
* Established effective data pipelines and database structures
* Delivered APIs and integrations required by the business
* Improved data quality and accessibility
* Reduced manual data\-processing requirements
* Worked effectively with frontend, AI and business teams
* Contributed to better technical documentation and development standards
* Helped create a stronger and more scalable technology foundation for GCRS

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing international business where technology is increasingly important to how we operate and deliver services.

You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful internal and client\-facing technology projects and contribute directly to the development of systems that support an international regulatory business.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person
